title: Sita brings laptops to Dolakha.
summary: After finishing her BSc.CSIT at Tribhuvan University, Sita returned to her public school in Dolakha to run weekend laptop clubs powered by solar-charged batteries.
quote: Teach For Nepal showed us that community teachers can lead the change. When the landslide cut power, our solar trunk kept everyone's coursework alive.
metrics: First woman coder from her ward
18 girls enrolled in the Dolakha laptop club

title: Bikash codes in Janakpur.
summary: Bikash uses refurbished tablets and free fiber from Nepal Telecom to host Scratch and Python sessions for students whose families migrate seasonally for work.
quote: Karkhana Samuha helped me design tinkering lessons in Maithili. Now parents stay in the classroom because they see their kids building apps for cooperatives.

title: Manju powers a solar classroom.
summary: Inspired by organisations like Women Leaders in Technology, Manju built a Nepali-language curriculum and a solar microgrid so girls in Bharatpur can code even during load-shedding.
quote: Room to Read helped our library years ago; this grant let us add laptops and LED lights so the lab never shuts down.
metrics: Hybrid design challenges with Siddhartha Bank mentors

title: Principal Rai scales leadership labs.
summary: Principal Rai worked with the Education Cluster, Teach For Nepal alumni, and our team to weave digital leadership labs into the Grade 9 science period.
quote: Retention is up 30 percent because students see pathways like Deerwalk, Fusemachines, and Khalti hiring Nepali talent.
metrics: Quarterly open classrooms for nearby schools
